{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment to check for imbalance
ct = pd.crosstab(filtered_df['channel'], filtered_df['customer_segment'])
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(ct)

# Compute average revenue per converted order within each segment
# Only include converted orders (converted = 1)
converted_only = filtered_df[filtered_df['converted'] == 1]

# Group by channel and segment
avg_revenue_by_channel_segment = converted_only.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\nAverage revenue per converted order by channel and segment:")
print(avg_revenue_by_channel_segment)

# Compute difference in average revenue per converted order within each segment
# Email - Paid_search
diff_by_segment = avg_revenue_by_channel_segment['email'] - avg_revenue_by_channel_segment['paid_search']
print("\nDifference (email - paid_search) in average revenue per converted order by segment:")
print(diff_by_segment)

# Compute overall average revenue per converted order for each channel (unadjusted)
overall_avg = filtered_df[filtered_df['converted'] == 1].groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean()
print("\nOverall average revenue per converted order (unadjusted):")
print(overall_avg)"}
